title: Rerun the old-Node check on the VM
goal: `nodes inspect --ssh nerv-linux` against Ubuntu's Node 18 fails naming the found and required versions
acceptance: On the VM with Ubuntu's packaged Node.js, `nodes inspect` saves the inspection and fails naming the found 18.x and the required version
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no real host names.
escalation: The VM has no outbound connection (2026-11-14): installing Node there waits for the owner to restore its network

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one install and one inspection on the VM. Not a measurement.
